title: Clinton briefed on UFOs by civilian Bruce Maccabee via Ron Pandolfi
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Clinton briefed on UFOs by civilian Bruce Maccabee via Ron Pandolfi, about 1990s at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Maccabee briefs Clinton's science adviser at short notice

plain: This story is about how a US president may have been told about UFOs in the 1990s. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Ron Pandolfi, who worked at the CIA (the US government's spy agency), helped arrange for a civilian UFO researcher named Bruce Maccabee to brief President Bill Clinton. A researcher named Jason Simosa tells it differently, as Maccabee himself told it: Maccabee, a Navy physicist, got a call from Pandolfi asking him to repeat a lecture he had once given the CIA, this time for the president's science adviser rather than Clinton himself. If true, it would mean UFO research reached the White House through quiet back channels.
